attrs.db.statement: SELECT a.id, a.role, a.customer_id, a.raw_sum_minor, coalesce((SELECT sum(p.amount_minor) FROM postings p WHERE p.account_id = a.id), 0)::bigint AS postings_sum FROM accounts a WHERE a.space_id = %s ORDER BY a.role, a.customer_id NULLS FIRST

SELECT t.id::text, t.kind, t.status, t.amount_minor, t.return_code, t.failure_reason, t.counterparty_name, t.created_at::text, (SELECT array_agg(e.event ORDER BY e.id) FROM transfer_events e WHERE e.transfer_id = t.id) AS events FROM transfers t WHERE t.space_id = %s ORDER BY t.created_at
SELECT c.display_name, c.kind, a.raw_sum_minor FROM customers c JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.id AND a.role = 'customer_deposit' WHERE c.space_id = %s
SELECT id::text, amount_minor, status, requested_by, approved_by FROM write_offs WHERE space_id = %s
SELECT * FROM recon_runs WHERE space_id = %s ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, kind, provider_txn_id, amount_minor, detail, status, note, created_at, resolved_at FROM recon_exceptions WHERE space_id = %s ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('fern.ai_budget'))
SELECT coalesce(sum(coalesce(cost_micros, reserved_micros)), 0)::bigint AS spent FROM ai_reports WHERE source <> 'rules' AND created_at >= date_trunc('day', now())
